item.title: Ask HN: Local-Only Microsoft Word?
item.summary: Let's say I bought a new PC. New, so running Windows 11. And let's say I wanted Microsoft Word, and thought that Libre Office wasn't good enough because reasons. And let's say I wanted Microsoft Word that lived on my PC , not off in the cloud somewhere - something I could still use even without an internet connection, and where all my files were local and stayed local. What was the last version of Word that was local-only? Can one still buy a new copy? If so, from where? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49286676 Points: 1 # Comments: 6
